rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING CERTAIN REQUIREMENTS TO INSURE CLEAN AND HONEST ELECTIONS OF MEMBERS OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF ELECTRIC COOPERATIVES AND THEREBY AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE PRESIDENTIAL DECREES NO. 269 AND 1645
rows.abstract: Rationale: Unfortunately , many electric cooperatives have virtually become the private preserve  of the members of their Board of Directors who utilize the cooperative for thier personal gain as well as dumping ground for the employment of their relatives and friends, thereby over staffing the coop  and increasing the cost of electricity. consequently, many coops are mismanaged and riddled with irregularities. As a result, many of them are not only behind in the payment of their loan amortizations, but are hugely indebted to the National Power Corporation. Electric consumers are the ones paying for the cost of their abuses. > Members of the board of directors of numerous electric cooperatives have managed to stay in power for a long time.. some of them even for more than a decade, through manipulation of the coop membership records and electoral process. District elections of electirc cooperatives are most often heavily tainted with electoral fraud.> Mandates  the National Electrific

rows.abstract: Rationale: Government officials, whether elected or appointed, owe it to the people to uphold the constitutional aphorism that "Public Office Is Public Trust" and therefore must be  held with the highest degree of sincerity and professionalism . > There are, however, appointed officials who are lured by the prestige and power seemingly attached to the public office they hold and therefore desire to further extend it through an elected office.  Most of the time, these appointed officials use their  present position as the take-off point of their political aspirations. > Declares it UNLAWFUL for any appointed government official to run for any elective public office WITHIN  THREE (3) YEARS from resignation or separation from service.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE AUTOMATIC ADJUSTMENT OF THE PENSION BENEFITS OF RETIRED PERSONNEL OF THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL POLICE, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE "THE DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT ACT OF 1990," AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Rationale: The police retirement system is glaringly unfair to its beneficiaries. The Armed Forces of the Philippines retirement system, to which the police retirement system was patterned, provides for adjustment of the retirement pay on the prevailing scale of basic pay of the military personnel in active service. Nowhere in the police retirement system is such provision found. > Seeks to correct the foregoing inequity by proposing the following amendment to the Local Government Code providion on retirement benefits of PNP personnel: "SEC. 75. X X X PROVIDED, THAT SUCH RETIREMENT PAY SHALL BE SUBJECT TO ADJUSTMENT BASED ON THE PREVAILING SCALE OF BASE PAY OF POLICE PERSONNEL IN THE ACTIVE SERVICE."
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SECURITY since 1997-11-19

rows.abstract: "Real Estate Commission Act of 1997" Declares it the policy of the State to safeguard public interest against unjustified or unreasonable increase in the prices of real estates, and in the interest of fair play, to regulate practices involving realestate business. Seeks to create the REAL ESTATE COMMISSION which shall be the SOLE estate regulating agency of the government. It shall cover both public and private real estates.

rows.abstract: "Downstream Oil Industry Deregulation Act of 1997" Provides for the following --- (1) Imposition of a uniform tariff structure of three percent (3%) for both crude oil and refined petroleum products. (2) Redefinition of predatory pricing to focus onpreventing the dominant players in the industry from discouraging new entrants in the markets.

rows.abstract: Mandates the following --- "SECTION 1. All vessel or cargo clearances issued or required by any government agency, bureau or office are hereby considered transferred to the Philippine Port Authority for the purpose of this Act."

rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING ALL PUBLIC EMPLOYEES IN THE GOVERNMENT A CREDIT-CHARACTE R LOAN OF ONE HUNDRED THOUSAND PESOS (P100,000.00) FROM THE GOVERNMENT SERVICE INSURANCE SYSTEM (GSIS) PAYABLE FROM THE PROCEEDS OF THEIR RETIREMENT AND GRATUITY BENEFITS AS THEIR COLLATERAL WHEN THEY RETIRE FROM THE SERVICE
rows.abstract: Declares the following --- "Section 1. All public employees shall upon application from the Government Insurance System (GSIS) be granted a credit-characte r loan of ONE HUNDRED THOUSAND PESOS (P100,000.00) payable from the proceeds of their retirement/grat uity benefits when they retire from the service plus five percent (5%) annual interest from the principal amount. Section 3. The loan capital plus the 5% interest earned shall be deducted against the retirement pay paid to the government employee upon their retirement from the service."
